disclaimer: This is a fictional competition in a synthetic market, not investment advice. A higher simulated return can reflect risk-taking and luck, not a better real-world investment decision.
rules: Both players receive the same budget, investment horizon and instrument whitelist.
Invest only in the listed instruments in the assigned category. Uninvested cash earns 0%.
No borrowing, leverage or short selling. Allocations cannot exceed the starting budget.
Confirmed allocation changes are saved to the server. At the planning deadline, the latest server-acknowledged portfolio is locked automatically.
Manual submission is final. No trading is allowed after submission or during the simulation.
Both portfolios experience the same synthetic market. The higher final portfolio value wins, even if both portfolios lose money. Equal final values to the cent are a draw.
If either portfolio has no invested money at timeout, the match is cancelled without ranking-point changes.
Instruments move independently in this model. Correlations, fees, taxes and inflation are not simulated.

templates.title: Research team showdown
templates.background: Two fictional research teams are testing different allocations among the same available company stocks. Each team starts with identical resources and faces the same synthetic market.
templates.objective: Build a stock portfolio and finish the shared investment horizon with a higher total value than the opposing team.

templates.title: The market basket challenge
templates.background: Two fictional market-lab teams are comparing allocations among the same equity ETFs. Both teams can hold cash and have the same starting budget and investment horizon.
templates.objective: Choose an equity ETF allocation and finish the shared investment horizon with a higher total portfolio value than the other team.
